kind: Future evidence-interpretation clarification, not retrospective scoring or new acceptance contract.
applies_to: Future frozen task/evidence profiles; existing exact-candidate G1-G9 verdicts unchanged.

layers.name: RAW_OBSERVATION
layers.example: Clang JSON omits virtual field on Further::value and contains OverrideAttr.

layers.name: SCOPED_SOURCE_RELATION
layers.example: The owned source marks override; selected declaration of both calls is Base::value; normalized full AST cast structures differ.
layers.cannot_infer: Every compiler serialization exposes all semantic properties or identical decl means identical dispatch.

layers.name: DOCUMENTATION_PROPOSITION
layers.example: For this pinned owned source/Clang/O0/native target, textual IR shows indirect versus direct calls.
layers.cannot_infer: Measured runtime values, actual OpenCV build behavior or general C++ correctness.

cross_language_relation_limits.boundary: A defined function type is not an ordinary function API; preserve declaration kind even if a task question incorrectly calls it a function.
A class field source can be relevant yet rejected by a callable-only helper; extraction admission is separate from fact truth and model input curation.
Outer factory, returned arrow, accessor and closure-local state are distinct scopes; truthiness is not undefined-only and identifier presence does not preserve the predicate.
Missing JSON flag remains unknown; inspect hierarchy, override attributes, call qualification and actual permitted compiler evidence before semantic claims.

acceptance_rule: A supported component observation cannot promote unrelated or critical unverified prose. G2/G3/G8 still require exact scope, contextual source interpretation and negative challenges. Hash/source membership alone is insufficient.
